versions.subject: Final update
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths'
    TargetObject|endswith:
        - '(Default)'
        - 'Path'
    Details|contains:
        # Add more suspicious paths or binaries as you see fit.
        - '\Users\Public'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '%temp%'
        - 'iex'
        - 'Invoke-'
        - 'rundll32'
        - 'regsvr32'
        - 'mshta'
        - 'cscript'
        - 'wscript'
        - '.bat'
        - '.hta'
        - '.dll'
        - '.ps1'
condition: selection
